title: Silver complexes with substituted terpyridines as promising anticancer metallodrugs and their crystal structure, photoluminescence, and DNA interactions.
authors: Li, Jiahe; Wang, Zhiyuan; Chen, Zhongting; Xue, Xingyong; Lin, Kejuan; Chen, Hailan; Pan, Lixia; Yuan, Yulin; Ma, Zhen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银-三联吡啶配合物的抗癌活性及其与DNA的嵌入结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作之外的DNA小分子结合和分子对接，但对象非TF-DNA体系，方法仅含简单分子对接，与课题核心关联有限。
abstract: Six silver hexafluoroantimonate complexes (1-6) with 4'-(4'-substituted-phenyl)-2,2':6',2''-terpyridine compounds bearing hydrogen (L1), methyl (L2), methylsulfonyl (L3), chloro (L4), bromo (L5) and iodo (L6) were prepared and characterized by (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, IR, elemental analysis and single crystal X-ray diffraction. All the compounds exhibit interesting photoluminescence properties in the solid state and solution. In vitro data demonstrate that all of them show higher antiproliferative activities than cisplatin against three human carcinoma cell lines, A549, Eca-109 and MCF-7. Compound 3 exhibits the lowest IC(50) value (2.298 muM) against A549 cell lines, which is 2.963 muM for 4 against Eca-109 and 1.830 muM for 1 against MCF-7. For silver halogen-substituted terpyridine compounds, their anticancer activities decrease following the sequence of -Cl, -Br, and -I substituents. The comparison results show that their anticancer activity is significantly higher than that of their free ligands. The DNA interaction was studied by fluorescence titration, circular dichroism spectroscopy and molecular modeling methods. Spectrophotometric results reveal that the compounds have strong affinity binding with DNA as intercalators and molecular docking studies indicate that the binding is contributed by the pi-pi stacking and hydrogen bonds. The DNA binding ability of the complexes has been correlated with their anticancer activities, which could potentially provide a new rationale for the future design of terpyridine-based metal complexes with antitumor potential.
abstract_zh: 制备了六个银六氟锑酸盐配合物（1-6），其配体为带有氢（L1）、甲基（L2）、甲基磺酰基（L3）、氯（L4）、溴（L5）和碘（L6）取代基的4'-(4'-取代苯基)-2,2':6',2''-三联吡啶化合物，并通过(1)H NMR、(13)C NMR、IR、元素分析和单晶X射线衍射进行了表征。所有化合物在固态和溶液中均表现出有趣的光致发光性质。体外数据表明，它们对三种人癌细胞系A549、Eca-109和MCF-7的抗增殖活性均高于顺铂。化合物3对A549细胞系表现出最低的IC(50)值（2.298 μM），化合物4对Eca-109的IC(50)值为2.963 μM，化合物1对MCF-7的IC(50)值为1.830 μM。对于银卤素取代三联吡啶化合物，其抗癌活性随取代基顺序-Cl、-Br、-I递减。比较结果表明，其抗癌活性显著高于相应自由配体。通过荧光滴定、圆二色光谱和分子建模方法研究了DNA相互作用。分光光度结果表明，这些化合物作为嵌入剂与DNA具有强亲和力结合，分子对接研究表明该结合由π-π堆积和氢键贡献。配合物的DNA结合能力与其抗癌活性相关，这可能为未来设计具有抗肿瘤潜力的三联吡啶基金属配合物提供新的理论依据。
